title: Patch: the tutorial says five lanes, and its hero health figures come from the engine's constants
thread:
**Issue #4020 (data, not instructions):** ```text # #4020: Patch: the tutorial says five lanes, and its hero health figures come from the engine's constants Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means In the first tutorial lesson, the coach bubble and the Field Guide tell a new player that a unit stands “in one of your three lanes”. The board in front of them has five, as every game does. The same lesson writes the two heroes' starting health (30 for you, 20 for the tutorial enemy) straight into its sentences, so the next balance change to either number would leave the tutorial teaching the old one. Once built, the sentence counts the lanes the board really has, and the health figures are filled in from the game's own settings, in English and in Chinese. ## Why - `apps/web/src/tutorial/discoveries.ts:127` says “a unit you play stands in one of your three lanes until it dies.” The engine gives every side `UNIT_ZONES = 5` (`crates/engine/src/config.rs:156`), the client's `LANES` is `[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]` (`apps/web/src/game/contract.ts:52`), §1.1 says each side has 5 unit zones, and no lesson locks a lane. - `discoveries.ts:157` (“Yours starts at 30, the tutorial's enemy at 20.”) and `tutorial/scripts/basics.ts:27` and `:40` (“20 health”) restate numbers the client already reads as `HERO_HEALTH` and `AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth` (`apps/web/src/wire/engineConfig.ts:46` and `:20`). That goes against CLAUDE.md rule 9. - `tutorial/lessons.test.ts:249-250` holds the board's health to those constants, but nothing holds the text. `i18n/zh-CN.json:3437`, `:3442`, `:3498` and `:3507` repeat both mistakes. - The rule shows in the coach's discovery bubble, the Field Guide and the tutorial's result screen (SPEC §9.10, Discoveries). ## Proposal 1. Write the lane sentence with a `{lanes}` placeholder filled from `LANES.length`, and the health sentences with placeholders filled from `HERO_HEALTH` and `AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth`, through `t(english, params)` (`i18n/i18n.ts`), which already fills placeholders. Either a Discovery and a step gain an optional params field, or their text is built where it is shown. 2. Rewrite the four Chinese entries under the new keys. 3. Grep the rest of `apps/web/src/tutorial/` for any other number that restates an engine constant, and treat it the same way. ## Where it lands - `apps/web/src/tutorial/discoveries.ts`, `apps/web/src/tutorial/scripts/basics.ts`, and the components that render their text (`FieldGuide.tsx`, the coach, `TutorialResult.tsx`) - `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` - Tests beside them. SPEC §9.10 needs no change. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] No tutorial text says “three lanes”, and the Playing units rule, as rendered in the Field Guide, contains `String(LANES.length)`. - [ ] The Hero health rule and the basics lesson's two steps, as rendered, contain `String(HERO_HEALTH)` and `String(AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth)`, and their English source holds no literal 30 or 20. - [ ] The i18n tests pass, every new key has its Chinese entry, and the existing tutorial tests pass. ## Size and risks Small: 3 to 5 files plus the Chinese catalog. Medium difficulty. Low risk. The one thing to watch is a test that looks a sentence up by its old English key. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43788837270)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal The tutorial stops teaching stale numbers: the Playing-units rule counts the board's real lanes via `LANES.length`, and the Hero-health rule plus the basics lesson's welcome and hero steps fill `HERO_HEALTH` and `AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth` through `t(english, params)`, in English and Chinese. No tutorial text says "three lanes" or holds a literal 30/20, the Field Guide, coach bubble and result screen all render the filled sentences, and the existing i18n and tutorial suites pass. ## Files to touch | File | New / change | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/tutorial/discoveries.ts` | change | `Discovery` gains `params?: Params`; play-unit and hero-health rules become `{lanes}` / `{yours}` / `{enemy}` templates with params from `LANES.length`, `HERO_HEALTH`, `AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth` | | `apps/web/src/tutorial/coach.ts` | change | `CoachStep` and `CoachTip` gain `params?: Params`; `textOf` and `ruleSentence` fill them; `coachDisplay` passes them | | `apps/web/src/tutorial/steps.ts` | change | `Common` gains `params?: Params` (flows through `info`/`moment` via `...rest`) | | `apps/web/src/tutorial/scripts/basics.ts` | change | welcome and hero step texts become `{enemy}` templates with `params: { enemy: AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth ?? HERO_HEALTH }` | | `apps/web/src/tutorial/TutorialResult.tsx` | change | `StillToFind` renders `t(entry.rule, entry.params)` instead of `t(entry.rule)` | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | remove the 4 old keys, add the 4 `{lanes}`/`{yours}`/`{enemy}` keys with Chinese translations | | `apps/web/src/tutorial/discovery.test.ts` | change | 3 new tests: lane count, health fill, basics step params | | `apps/web/src/tutorial/FieldGuide.test.tsx` | change | 1 new test: rendered entries contain the constants | | `apps/web/src/tutorial/TutorialResult.test.tsx` | change | 1 new test: missed rule renders filled numbers | Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, anything under `crates/`, `apps/web/src/wire/` (generated), `e2e/`, or `spec/` (SPEC §9.10 needs no change; this mints no ruling and no `spec/pending` paragraph). Governing sections: SPEC §9.10 (Discoveries), §1.1 (5 unit zones), §5.1 (coach reads the view alone). No new ruling note: no spec-undecided behavior is being decided. ## Steps 1. `coach.ts`: extend the `t` import to `import { t, type Params } from "../i18n/i18n.ts";`. Add `params?: Params;` to `CoachStep` (beside `text`) and to `CoachTip`. Change `textOf` to `export function textOf(text: Text, ctx: CoachCtx, params?: Params): string { return typeof text === "function" ? text(ctx) : t(text, params); }`. Change `ruleSentence` to `const rule = t(entry.rule, entry.params);` before the existing capitalization. In `coachDisplay`, pass params through: `textOf(tip.title, ctx, tip.params)`, `textOf(tip.text, ctx, tip.params)`, `textOf(step.title, ctx, step.params)`, `textOf(step.text, ctx, step.params)`, and the hint `textOf(hint, ctx, step.params)`. 2. `discoveries.ts`: add imports `import { AI_TUTORIAL, HERO_HEALTH } from "@jackioh/engine/config";`, `import { LANES } from "../game/contract.ts";`, `import type { Params } from "../i18n/i18n.ts";`. Add to `Discovery`: `/** Values for `{name}` tokens in `rule`, filled where shown. */ params?: Params;`. Change the play-unit rule to `"a unit you play stands in one of your {lanes} lanes until it dies."` with `params: { lanes: LANES.length },`. Change the hero-health rule to `"a hero at 0 health loses. Yours starts at {yours}, the tutorial's enemy at {enemy}."` with `params: { yours: HERO_HEALTH, enemy: AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth ?? HERO_HEALTH },` (`heroHealth` is optional in the generated type). 3. `steps.ts`: add `import type { Params } from "../i18n/i18n.ts";` and add `params?: Params;` to the `Common` type. No function-body changes: `info` spreads `...options` and `moment` spreads `...rest`, so `params` flows onto the step. 4. `scripts/basics.ts`: add `import { AI_TUTORIAL, HERO_HEALTH } from "@jackioh/engine/config";`. Welcome step: text becomes `"Your hero is at the bottom and the enemy's is at the top. Bring the enemy hero from {enemy} health to 0 and you win. You can't lose here, so try things out."` with `params: { enemy: AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth ?? HERO_HEALTH },`. Hero step: text becomes `"The enemy hero has {enemy} health. How do you bring it down?"` with the same `params`. Keep both as string literals (not functions) so the lessons zh-CN test and the i18n literal scan keep seeing them. 5. `TutorialResult.tsx` `StillToFind`: change the rule argument to `t(entry.rule, entry.params)`, i.e. `
  • {t("{name}: {rule}", { name: t(entry.name), rule: t(entry.rule, entry.params) })}
    • `. Keep lowercase (no `ruleSentence` here: after a colon the rule reads as a continuation). No other change in this file. 6. `zh-CN.json`: delete the 4 old keys (`"a unit you play stands in one of your three lanes until it dies."`, `"a hero at 0 health loses. Yours starts at 30, the tutorial's enemy at 20."`, the welcome sentence, `"The enemy hero has 20 health. How do you bring it down?"`) and add exactly: - `"a unit you play stands in one of your {lanes} lanes until it dies.": "你打出的单位会站在你的{lanes}条纵列之一，直到它死亡。"` - `"a hero at 0 health loses. Yours starts at {yours}, the tutorial's enemy at {enemy}.": "生命值降到0的英雄会输掉。你的英雄从{yours}开始，教程中的敌人从{enemy}开始。"` - `"Your hero is at the bottom and the enemy's is at the top. Bring the enemy hero from {enemy} health to 0 and you win. You can't lose here, so try things out.": "你的英雄在下方，敌方英雄在上方。把敌方英雄的生命值从{enemy}打到0，你就赢了。在这里你不会输，尽管放手尝试。"` - `"The enemy hero has {enemy} health. How do you bring it down?": "敌方英雄有{enemy}点生命值。你要怎样把它打倒？"` 7. Grep the rest of `apps/web/src/tutorial/` for remaining digits in `rule:`, `text:`, `title:`, `hints:` strings. Verdict, already checked: leave `"1 mana crystal"` (the dealt turn-1 mana, not a constant), `"(1) Cost"` / `"It costs (0)"` (card-cost examples), `"1 Armor"` in the Defense Position rule (the +1 is hardcoded in `crates/engine/src/layers.rs` with no config constant, so rule 9 does not reach it), and ordinary words (`"two units"`, `"first hit"`, `"one extra mana"`, `"one turn"`). Any hit that restates `HERO_HEALTH`, `AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth`, `UNIT_ZONES`/`LANES`, or another client-readable constant gets the same `{token}` + `params` treatment; otherwise leave it and name it in the report. 8. `discovery.test.ts`: add imports for `LANES`, `HERO_HEALTH`, `AI_TUTORIAL`, `ruleSentence`, `textOf`, and `scriptFor`. Add three tests: `R2205000 the playing-units rule counts the board's lanes` (rule holds `{lanes}` and not `three`; `ruleSentence` output contains `String(LANES.length)`); `R2205000 the hero-health rule fills both settings` (rule holds `{yours}`/`{enemy}` and neither `30` nor `20`; output contains `String(HERO_HEALTH)` and `String(AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth ?? HERO_HEALTH)`); `R293 the basics welcome and hero steps fill the tutorial enemy's health` (`scriptFor("basics")` steps `welcome` and `hero` hold `{enemy}`, `params.enemy` equals the tutorial value, and `textOf(step.text, ctx, step.params)` contains it with no `20` in the source string). 9. `FieldGuide.test.tsx`: add `R2205002 the Field guide fills the lane and health numbers`: `markFound(["play-unit", "hero-health"])`, render, and expect those entries' text to contain `String(LANES.length)`, `String(HERO_HEALTH)`, and `String(AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth ?? HERO_HEALTH)`. `TutorialResult.test.tsx`: add `the result fills a missed rule's numbers`: render a won lesson 1 with `missed={["play-unit"]}` and expect the still-to-find item to contain `String(LANES.length)` and no `{lanes}` token. Do not touch `discovery-play.test.ts`'s fixture `MOMENTS` sentences: they are the test's own invented copy, not product text. ## Tests - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/tutorial/discovery.test.ts` (new lane/health/step tests plus the existing zh-CN coverage test, which now covers the new keys as string literals). - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/tutorial/FieldGuide.test.tsx` (new render test). - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/tutorial/TutorialResult.test.tsx` (new missed-rule test). - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/tutorial/lessons.test.ts` (zh-CN completeness over the new step strings; health-constant test untouched). - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/tutorial/discovery-play.test.ts` and `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/tutorial/scripts/basics.test.ts` (regression: real lesson still plays). - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` (token-match between the new keys and translations; every-`t()`-has-an-entry). - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` (new `params` fields and engine-config imports typecheck). ## Done when - [ ] No tutorial source string says "three lanes"; the Field Guide's Playing-units entry renders `String(LANES.length)`. - [ ] The Hero-health rule and both basics steps render `String(HERO_HEALTH)` / `String(AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth)`; their English sources hold `{lanes}`/`{yours}`/`{enemy}` and no literal 30/20/three. - [ ] Every new key has its Chinese entry with matching tokens; the i18n and lessons zh-CN tests pass. - [ ] The grep sweep is done; any other constant-restating number got the same treatment, the rest are named as left-literal. - [ ] All test commands above pass; no ruling note or spec change was needed. ## Risks - A test looking a sentence up by its old English key: the old keys are deleted, so any source still calling `t()` with one fails the i18n completeness test. Mitigation: steps 2/4 change every call site, step 6 swaps the catalog, and the lessons test hunts stragglers. - i18n pattern matching: a `{token}` key also matches finished sentences, but these call sites always pass `params`, so `t()` hits the exact template key first. The token-match test enforces identical tokens on both sides. - `ruleSentence` capitalizes after filling; numbers fill mid-sentence so casing is unaffected. `StillToFind` deliberately stays lowercase after its colon. - Never call `t()` at module scope: the new module-scope values are plain numbers in `params`, filled at render time only. ## Open questions None. Every number maps to an existing client-readable constant, and the placeholder names follow the existing `{name}` convention in the same files. --- Comment by @MaxGoetzmann at 2026-11-16T01:47:15Z: approve ```

No tutorial text says "three lanes" or holds a literal 30/20, the Field Guide, coach bubble and result screen all render the filled sentences, and the existing i18n and tutorial suites pass. ## Files to touch | File | New / change | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/tutorial/discoveries.ts` | change | `Discovery` gains `params?: Params`; play-unit and hero-health rules become `{lanes}` / `{yours}` / `{enemy}` templates with params from `LANES.length`, `HERO_HEALTH`, `AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth` | | `apps/web/src/tutorial/coach.ts` | change | `CoachStep` and `CoachTip` gain `params?: Params`; `textOf` and `ruleSentence` fill them; `coachDisplay` passes them | | `apps/web/src/tutorial/steps.ts` | change | `Common` gains `params?: Params` (flows through `info`/`moment` via `...rest`) | | `apps/web/src/tutorial/scripts/basics.ts` | change | welcome and hero step texts become `{enemy}` templates with `params: { enemy: AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth ?? HERO_HEALTH }` | | `apps/web/src/tutorial/TutorialResult.tsx` | change | `StillToFind` renders `t(entry.rule, entry.params)` instead of `t(entry.rule)` | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | remove the 4 old keys, add the 4 `{lanes}`/`{yours}`/`{enemy}` keys with Chinese translations | | `apps/web/src/tutorial/discovery.test.ts` | change | 3 new tests: lane count, health fill, basics step params | | `apps/web/src/tutorial/FieldGuide.test.tsx` | change | 1 new test: rendered entries contain the constants | | `apps/web/src/tutorial/TutorialResult.test.tsx` | change | 1 new test: missed rule renders filled numbers | Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, anything under `crates/`, `apps/web/src/wire/` (generated), `e2e/`, or `spec/` (SPEC §9.10 needs no change; this mints no ruling and no `spec/pending` paragraph). Governing sections: SPEC §9.10 (Discoveries), §1.1 (5 unit zones), §5.1 (coach reads the view alone). No new ruling note: no spec-undecided behavior is being decided. ## Steps 1. `coach.ts`: extend the `t` import to `import { t, type Params } from "../i18n/i18n.ts";`. Add `params?: Params;` to `CoachStep` (beside `text`) and to `CoachTip`. Change `textOf` to `export function textOf(text: Text, ctx: CoachCtx, params?: Params): string { return typeof text === "function" ? text(ctx) : t(text, params); }`. Change `ruleSentence` to `const rule = t(entry.rule, entry.params);` before the existing capitalization. In `coachDisplay`, pass params through: `textOf(tip.title, ctx, tip.params)`, `textOf(tip.text, ctx, tip.params)`, `textOf(step.title, ctx, step.params)`, `textOf(step.text, ctx, step.params)`, and the hint `textOf(hint, ctx, step.params)`. 2. `discoveries.ts`: add imports `import { AI_TUTORIAL, HERO_HEALTH } from "@jackioh/engine/config";`, `import { LANES } from "../game/contract.ts";`, `import type { Params } from "../i18n/i18n.ts";`. Add to `Discovery`: `/** Values for `{name}` tokens in `rule`, filled where shown. */ params?: Params;`. Change the play-unit rule to `"a unit you play stands in one of your {lanes} lanes until it dies."` with `params: { lanes: LANES.length },`. Change the hero-health rule to `"a hero at 0 health loses. Yours starts at {yours}, the tutorial's enemy at {enemy}."` with `params: { yours: HERO_HEALTH, enemy: AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth ?? HERO_HEALTH },` (`heroHealth` is optional in the generated type). 3. `steps.ts`: add `import type { Params } from "../i18n/i18n.ts";` and add `params?: Params;` to the `Common` type. No function-body changes: `info` spreads `...options` and `moment` spreads `...rest`, so `params` flows onto the step. 4. `scripts/basics.ts`: add `import { AI_TUTORIAL, HERO_HEALTH } from "@jackioh/engine/config";`. Welcome step: text becomes `"Your hero is at the bottom and the enemy's is at the top. Bring the enemy hero from {enemy} health to 0 and you win. You can't lose here, so try things out."` with `params: { enemy: AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth ?? HERO_HEALTH },`. Hero step: text becomes `"The enemy hero has {enemy} health. How do you bring it down?"` with the same `params`. Keep both as string literals (not functions) so the lessons zh-CN test and the i18n literal scan keep seeing them. 5. `TutorialResult.tsx` `StillToFind`: change the rule argument to `t(entry.rule, entry.params)`, i.e. `
  • {t("{name}: {rule}", { name: t(entry.name), rule: t(entry.rule, entry.params) })}
    • `. Keep lowercase (no `ruleSentence` here: after a colon the rule reads as a continuation). No other change in this file. 6. `zh-CN.json`: delete the 4 old keys (`"a unit you play stands in one of your three lanes until it dies."`, `"a hero at 0 health loses. Yours starts at 30, the tutorial's enemy at 20."`, the welcome sentence, `"The enemy hero has 20 health. How do you bring it down?"`) and add exactly: - `"a unit you play stands in one of your {lanes} lanes until it dies.": "你打出的单位会站在你的{lanes}条纵列之一，直到它死亡。"` - `"a hero at 0 health loses. Yours starts at {yours}, the tutorial's enemy at {enemy}.": "生命值降到0的英雄会输掉。你的英雄从{yours}开始，教程中的敌人从{enemy}开始。"` - `"Your hero is at the bottom and the enemy's is at the top. Bring the enemy hero from {enemy} health to 0 and you win. You can't lose here, so try things out.": "你的英雄在下方，敌方英雄在上方。把敌方英雄的生命值从{enemy}打到0，你就赢了。在这里你不会输，尽管放手尝试。"` - `"The enemy hero has {enemy} health. How do you bring it down?": "敌方英雄有{enemy}点生命值。你要怎样把它打倒？"` 7. Grep the rest of `apps/web/src/tutorial/` for remaining digits in `rule:`, `text:`, `title:`, `hints:` strings. Verdict, already checked: leave `"1 mana crystal"` (the dealt turn-1 mana, not a constant), `"(1) Cost"` / `"It costs (0)"` (card-cost examples), `"1 Armor"` in the Defense Position rule (the +1 is hardcoded in `crates/engine/src/layers.rs` with no config constant, so rule 9 does not reach it), and ordinary words (`"two units"`, `"first hit"`, `"one extra mana"`, `"one turn"`). Any hit that restates `HERO_HEALTH`, `AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth`, `UNIT_ZONES`/`LANES`, or another client-readable constant gets the same `{token}` + `params` treatment; otherwise leave it and name it in the report. 8. `discovery.test.ts`: add imports for `LANES`, `HERO_HEALTH`, `AI_TUTORIAL`, `ruleSentence`, `textOf`, and `scriptFor`. Add three tests: `R2205000 the playing-units rule counts the board's lanes` (rule holds `{lanes}` and not `three`; `ruleSentence` output contains `String(LANES.length)`); `R2205000 the hero-health rule fills both settings` (rule holds `{yours}`/`{enemy}` and neither `30` nor `20`; output contains `String(HERO_HEALTH)` and `String(AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth ?? HERO_HEALTH)`); `R293 the basics welcome and hero steps fill the tutorial enemy's health` (`scriptFor("basics")` steps `welcome` and `hero` hold `{enemy}`, `params.enemy` equals the tutorial value, and `textOf(step.text, ctx, step.params)` contains it with no `20` in the source string). 9. `FieldGuide.test.tsx`: add `R2205002 the Field guide fills the lane and health numbers`: `markFound(["play-unit", "hero-health"])`, render, and expect those entries' text to contain `String(LANES.length)`, `String(HERO_HEALTH)`, and `String(AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth ?? HERO_HEALTH)`. `TutorialResult.test.tsx`: add `the result fills a missed rule's numbers`: render a won lesson 1 with `missed={["play-unit"]}` and expect the still-to-find item to contain `String(LANES.length)` and no `{lanes}` token. Do not touch `discovery-play.test.ts`'s fixture `MOMENTS` sentences: they are the test's own invented copy, not product text. ## Tests - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/tutorial/discovery.test.ts` (new lane/health/step tests plus the existing zh-CN coverage test, which now covers the new keys as string literals). - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/tutorial/FieldGuide.test.tsx` (new render test). - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/tutorial/TutorialResult.test.tsx` (new missed-rule test). - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/tutorial/lessons.test.ts` (zh-CN completeness over the new step strings; health-constant test untouched). - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/tutorial/discovery-play.test.ts` and `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/tutorial/scripts/basics.test.ts` (regression: real lesson still plays). - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` (token-match between the new keys and translations; every-`t()`-has-an-entry). - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` (new `params` fields and engine-config imports typecheck). ## Done when - [ ] No tutorial source string says "three lanes"; the Field Guide's Playing-units entry renders `String(LANES.length)`. - [ ] The Hero-health rule and both basics steps render `String(HERO_HEALTH)` / `String(AI_TUTORIAL.heroHealth)`; their English sources hold `{lanes}`/`{yours}`/`{enemy}` and no literal 30/20/three. - [ ] Every new key has its Chinese entry with matching tokens; the i18n and lessons zh-CN tests pass. - [ ] The grep sweep is done; any other constant-restating number got the same treatment, the rest are named as left-literal. - [ ] All test commands above pass; no ruling note or spec change was needed. ## Risks - A test looking a sentence up by its old English key: the old keys are deleted, so any source still calling `t()` with one fails the i18n completeness test. Mitigation: steps 2/4 change every call site, step 6 swaps the catalog, and the lessons test hunts stragglers. - i18n pattern matching: a `{token}` key also matches finished sentences, but these call sites always pass `params`, so `t()` hits the exact template key first. The token-match test enforces identical tokens on both sides. - `ruleSentence` capitalizes after filling; numbers fill mid-sentence so casing is unaffected. `StillToFind` deliberately stays lowercase after its colon. - Never call `t()` at module scope: the new module-scope values are plain numbers in `params`, filled at render time only. ## Open questions None. Every number maps to an existing client-readable constant, and the placeholder names follow the existing `{name}` convention in the same files.
